lanserverproperties.options.online_mode..en: Enabling online mode will only allow players logged in with valid Microsoft/Mojang accounts to join the LAN server.
lanserverproperties.options.online_mode..zh: 启用在线模式将只允许使用微软/Mojang帐户登录的玩家加入本服务器.

lanserverproperties.options.online_mode..en: Disabling online mode will allow anyone to join the LAN server.
lanserverproperties.options.online_mode..zh: 禁用在线模式将允许非正版玩家加入.

lanserverproperties.options.online_mode..en: This mode will allow anyone to join the LAN server while retaining the UUID for those who logged in with their Microsoft/Mojang accounts. Use this mode if you are migrating from the online mode and want to retain the inventories.
lanserverproperties.options.online_mode..zh: 此模式将允许任何人加入本服务器, 同时为使用微软/Mojang帐户登录的用户保留UUID. 如果您正在从在线模式迁移, 请使用此模式, 它可以防止背包和物品栏内容丢失.

lanserverproperties.options.preference_e.en: Automatically load the settings from the stored preference, if the server is not published. Otherwise, this window displays the current configuration of the server.
lanserverproperties.options.preference_e.zh: 打开本窗口时自动读取已存配置,只在服务器未开放时生效,服务器开放后本页面默认显示当前服务器配置.

lanserverproperties.gui.always_offline.zh: 强制离线模式的玩家名列表

lanserverproperties.gui.always_offline.m.en: A list of space-separated player names that are always considered offline. Only valid in the 'Offline Mode + UUID Fix' mode and can be helpful to resolve the name collision between an offline player and a registered online player.
lanserverproperties.gui.always_offline.m.zh: 在本列表使用空格分隔，只在'离线模式+UUID修复模式'中有效. 若发生离线玩家与已注册的正版版玩家名字冲突, 可将离线玩家名字加入这里.
